MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 34
   C. 17
   D. 22

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 22

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)

   B. 21
   C. 42

   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)

   C. 37
   D. 2

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 46
   C. 30
   D. 23

11. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 8
   D. 24.5

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

14. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 6

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

18. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

20. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

21. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 15

22. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 13

23. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

24. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 28

25. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

26. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

27. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40

   C. 10
   D. 400

28. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)

   D. 49

29. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

30. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24
